siteDescription: Stories, memory and heritage of Lara.

hero.title: The stories Lara tells
hero.text: Photographs, voices and places that keep the memory of our region alive.

about.title: About Lara Cuenta
about.text: Lara Cuenta is a nano-outlet that collects the stories, places and customs of Lara, told through the people who live them.
about.body: We document how Lara has changed, the places that hold its memory, the people who shape it and the customs that define it. Every story starts with a photograph.

contact.title: Contact
contact.text: Have a question, a story to share or a topic we should cover? Write to us.
